projects.name: LLM Agent Interpretability - Classifier for detecting hallucinations in tool calling
projects.description: I trained and evaluated lightweight classifiers (MLP) on the internal state of Qwen3.5-9B and LLama-3.1-8B-Instruct while they performed inference on tool calling tasks from the BFCL benchmark. The goal was to understand if tool calling hallucinations could be predicted.
highlights: It was demonstrated that uncertainty encoding within the model occurs in the intermediate layers, making it possible to predict these hallucinations using a specialized guard rail system.
